title.narrative: Kvinna till kvinna GBV and women economic empowerment Serbia 2022-2026
Kvinna till kvinna GBV och kvinnors ekonomiska egenmakt Serbien 2022-2026

description.narrative: Kvinna till kvinna and partner organisations influence improvements in policy and practice regarding GBV and women's economic empowerment.
Kvinna till kvinna och samarbetsorganisationer påverkar förbättringar i policy och praxis när det gäller GBV och kvinnors ekonomiska egenmakt.

The objectives of the contribution are:
Overall Programme objective: Kvinna till Kvinna and partner organisations influence improvements in policy and practice regarding gender-based violence and womens economic empowerment in Serbia.
Specific objective 1 - Partner organisations and other relevant actors reached within the Project contribute to changes in attitude, practice and policy regarding GBV, based on the Istanbul Convention
Specific objective 2 - Organisations reached within the Project contribute to changes in policy and practice regarding womens economic empowerment.
Specific objective 3 - Increased sustainability and visibility of partner organisations and other relevant actors within the Project, and for their results

sector.narrative: Ending violence against women and girls
Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative: The Programme supported 6 implementing partner organisations in the reporting period, with a good geographical coverage. The organisations are form Prijepolje, Tutin, Zrenjanin, Beograd, Uzice. The overview of IPs and their projects under this programme is annexed to the report. The Autonomous Womens Center Belgrade (AWC) receives core support under the programme. The AWC work relates mainly to improved institutional framework for preventing the GBV. AWC also holds an SOS line that in the reporting period received 3 934 calls. AWC also provides email consultancy to the victims of the GBV. The AWC is a member of local, regional and some international CS networks. AWC works also actively on raising awareness related to GBV. Womens Center Uzice also receives core support. Their main activities relate to direct support to victims of GBV. The public launch of the Programme was organised in Uzice and hosted by this organisation on 15 Dec 2022 with Sida participation. The event gathered important attention at local media. One example of good signs of results is also ROZA's project (Zrenjanin), which is mainly focused at developing organisational capacities for nationallevel advocacy towards increased womens economic empowerment. During the reporting period, the organisation undertook important activities related to own capacity development and in putting together their own Advocacy Strategy. They have also established cooperation with four other CSOs in the country for the purpose of joint advocacy, and to introduce together the topic of labour rights into high school curricula. One of the important results is a baseline study that was developed together with the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Plan, in cooperation with an external consultant, expert in monitoring and evaluation. The monitoring and reporting will be used for 2023, as it the 2022 year was too short to both complete the study make use of it.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
